name: andy
description: A TypeScript-first, plugin-native secure AI agent runtime.

scripts.build: bun run --filter './packages/*' build && bun run --filter './plugins/*' build && bun run --filter './apps/*' build
scripts.build:release: bun run build && bun run build:plugin-binaries && bun run build:binary && bun run build:daemon-binary && bun run package:release
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run fmt:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter './packages/*' check && bun run --filter './plugins/*' check && bun run --filter './apps/*' check
